_doc: Life-sim event cards. ages [min,max]; req (see Life.meets); choices → weighted outcomes with fx, flags, career, standing, person, lose, best, death, or a 3D scene with success/fail outcomes.

events.title: First storm
events.text: The first storm of your life. The raft bucks like an animal. Somebody has to hold you.

out.text: You scream through every gust. Afterwards everyone swears you scared the storm off.
You sleep through the whole thing. The old women say that means something. They argue about what.

events.title: First word
events.text: You say your first word. Everyone leans in.

out.text: Of course it was "water". The raft laughs for a week.
"Lamp", pointing at the Beacon on the horizon. Your mother goes quiet.
A word nobody knows. You say it again at night, to the floorboards.

events.title: Learning to swim
events.text: They lower you into the water on a rope, the way every raft child learns.

out.text: You swim like a dog in a hurry. It counts.
You swallow half the Drift and come up blue. You learn anyway.
You lie on your back and look at the sky. You are very good at being still in water. That will matter.

events.title: Your first bracelet
events.text: Raft children get a rope bracelet in their raft's colour at five.

out.text: You wear it until it rots, and then you wear the rot.

choices.label: Trade it for a fish hook

out.text: You trade it to a Drifter kid for a fish hook. Your mother is livid. The hook is excellent.

events.title: The tally cord
events.text: Dive-crew children get their first tally cord at five. No marks on it yet.

out.text: "When you can hold your breath longer than your temper," says {mentor}.
Raft kids stare at it anyway. You learn early what the cord means to other people.

events.title: A gull
events.text: A gull with a bent wing starts following you around the deck.

out.text: It follows you for years. You call it Captain. It never learns anything.
It goes. Some days you look for it anyway.

events.title: Deck school
events.text: School is a tarp, a chalkboard and Teacher Nell, who was a Highmark clerk once.

out.text: You learn to read on ration notices. You learn to count on ration notices.
You learn the names of every wave instead. Nell writes "dreamy" on your slate.
You get sent to scrub the hull. Worth it.

events.title: A friend in the fog
events.text: Your best friend {friend} goes out on a skiff toward the Hush on a dare.

out.text: The fog takes the sound from everything. You both come back, barely, and never talk about what you heard.
You turn back halfway. They don't. They are never found.
They are hauled back, furious at you. Alive, though.
By the time anyone goes, the fog has them. You are not to blame. You blame yourself.
They come back at dawn, white as paper, and never go near the fog again.

events.title: New kid
events.text: A family ties up from another raft. They have a kid your age who stands too close to everyone.

out.text: You become inseparable the way only children can.
They make friends with someone else. You pretend not to mind.

events.title: A cough
events.text: You catch a cough. On the rafts, every cough is still a little frightening.

out.text: It passes. The fear in your mother's face doesn't, quite.
She sits up with you three nights running, listening to your voice. It doesn't go.

events.title: The sealed tin
events.text: A sealed Highmark tin rolls off a trader's stall and stops at your feet.

out.text: The trader gives you a dried fig for your honesty. It is the best thing you have ever eaten.
Fish. Real fish. You share it with nobody and feel strange about it for years.
A Warden on inspection sees the seal in your hands. Your family pays a fine they can't afford.

events.title: Ration day
events.text: Ration day. The Ward launch ties up and everyone lines up by wristband colour.

out.text: You watch a Warden count your family's bars twice and give you one fewer.
He looks at you a long time. Then he slips you an extra bar. "Don't tell."
"Because." Your father pulls you away by the collar.

events.title: The Beacon
events.text: At night you count the Beacon's sweeps from the stern until you fall asleep.

out.text: Fifteen seconds every turn. You could set your heart by it.
Sometimes, after it passes, the water hums. You decide not to tell anyone.

events.title: Overboard
events.text: You fall between two rafts during a swell.

out.text: You catch a mooring line and hang there until someone hauls you up by the hair.
You go under the barge. In the green dark something hums at you. Then hands, and air.
You float up into a gap and breathe. You were never scared. That frightens the adults more.

events.title: Storm drill
events.text: The raft runs a storm drill. Children carry lamps to the lashing points.

out.text: Your lamp is first at every post. The steward ruffles your hair.
You end up carrying two lamps and a crying five-year-old. You are late. Nobody minds.

events.title: Candle on the water
events.text: The Vigil sets candles on the water for the drowned. A child is allowed to set one.

out.text: It floats a long way. The Keeper says it found someone.
"Down," says the Keeper. "Everything goes down eventually. That isn't sad."

events.title: The forge
events.text: The Rusthold forge is warm and forbidden.

out.text: You learn to strike a spark. You also learn what a burn feels like.

choices.label: Ask the smith to teach you

out.text: She lets you work the bellows for a year. Your arms get strong.

events.title: Seeds
events.text: Elder Koa gives every Greentide child a seed on their eighth birthday.

out.text: A bean vine climbs the rain-catcher. You check on it every morning like a sibling.
You keep it for years. Everyone needs something that might still grow.

events.title: Fog lessons
events.text: On Lowlight, children learn to move through fog by sound alone.

out.text: You can find the galley blindfolded from anywhere on the raft.
You hate it, and it knows, and you get lost twice.

events.title: Highmark school
events.text: Lower-ring school on Highmark. Real desks. Real books. A portrait of the Chancellor.

out.text: You learn the Concord's history by heart. It is very tidy.
The teacher says raft-folk are "our partners in supply". She does not look at you when she says it.

events.title: Your parent is hurt
events.text: Your {mentor}... no, your mother comes home with her hand wrapped in a sail.

out.text: You do her shifts for a month. You are too small for it and you do it anyway.
She heals. She notices you didn't help. She never says so.

events.title: A bottle
events.text: A bottle with a note in it bumps against the raft.

out.text: "If anyone finds this, the Morrow family survived the Rise on the roof of the Kessler building. We waited." The date is twenty years old.

choices.label: Write back and throw it out again

out.text: You write your name and your raft. Years later, someone writes back.

events.title: Watching the divers
events.text: You watch the Deep-Born crews go down off the edge of the raft.

choices.label: Count how long they stay down

out.text: Two minutes. Three. You hold your breath with them until you see stars.

choices.label: Ask one of them what it's like

out.text: She shows you the tally on her sleeve. "Like being listened to," she says.
Everyone else does. You do. The diver doesn't even look up.

events.title: Breath games
events.text: The crew children have breath-holding contests off the stern.

out.text: You stay under until they pull you up by the ankle. You win.
You black out. You wake up on the deck with the whole crew staring.
She is insufferable about it for a year.

events.title: A rival
events.text: {rival} decides you are their enemy. You are not sure why.

out.text: You both lose teeth. It is a good fight. You are rivals for life.
It takes a year. Then it's easy.
They don't want to be your friend. They want to be your rival.

events.title: A new sibling
events.text: A baby is born into your family. Everything smells of milk and salt.

out.text: You carry them everywhere. They will follow you for the rest of your life.
You are jealous for exactly a year, then forget why.

events.title: Fever
events.text: A fever comes through the raft. Three children are very sick. You are one of them.

out.text: You come out the other side thinner and stubborn.
You nearly don't. You remember voices underwater the whole time.

events.title: Collision
events.text: Two rafts collide in the night. Your bunk ends up on the floor.

out.text: You push with your whole small body. It might even have helped.
You hide in a locker until morning. Nobody notices you were gone, which is worse.

events.title: The inspector
events.text: A Highmark inspector visits. White coat, gloves, a little book.

out.text: "Numbers," he says, and smiles, and writes one down. Your father goes grey.
Your family's ration is cut for a season. Some of the adults look at you with something like pride.

events.title: The old song
events.text: Someone on the raft has an old wind-up player and exactly one record.

out.text: "Hold the light for me." You sing it for the rest of your life, slightly wrong.

choices.label: Ask what the world was like

out.text: "Dry," the old man says. "Loud. We complained a lot." He laughs until he coughs.

events.title: The Choosing Night
events.text: At fourteen, on the Choosing Night, raft children pick the path they'll be apprenticed to.

out.text: You choose the water. Some people stop standing next to you.
You choose the deck. Solid, decent, damp.
You choose the bench. Your hands will never be clean again.
You choose nothing. The adults sigh. You feel free.

events.title: First dive
events.text: {mentor} takes you to the drowned lobby under Linden Court for your first real dive.

out.text: You go down.

success.text: You come up with a toolbox and a grin that won't leave. Your first tally mark.
success.best: Your first dive, under Linden Court.

fail.text: Your air goes and the hands that pull you up are the only reason you're alive. You dive again anyway, later.

out.text: You can't. Not yet. {mentor} doesn't push.

events.title: First crush
events.text: You can't stop looking at someone across the market deck.

out.text: You say something stupid. They laugh. Then they say something stupid back.
They look at your wrist, and away.
You never send it. You keep it for years.

events.title: A fight
events.text: Someone on the deck calls your family "Ward-lickers" — or "dive-dirt". Everyone is watching.

out.text: You win, mostly. The steward makes you both scrub the bilge together.
You lose. Badly. People respect you more anyway.
It costs more than the fight would have. You do it anyway.
You turn it into a joke and they can't follow up. A useful trick.
It doesn't land. They hit you anyway.

events.title: A locker
events.text: A trader's locker is open and nobody is looking.

out.text: A battery and a jar of honey. Nobody finds out. You eat the honey alone.
Caught. The raft votes on your punishment. You scrub hulls for a season.
The trader never knows. You do.

events.title: An offer
events.text: {mentor} offers to take you on properly.

out.text: You follow them for three years and learn everything they know that can be taught.
You want to learn your own mistakes. You do.

events.title: The Stacks crew
events.text: Kids from the Stacks run errands for the night market. They want you.

out.text: Fast money, faster friends. You learn every hiding place on Portage.
They stop talking to you. One of them gets arrested a year later.

events.title: Conscription
events.text: A Tide Ward recruiter ties up on ration day with a list of names. Yours is on it.

out.text: Black wristband, navy coat. Your old friends don't meet your eye on the dock.
You hide for three days. They take someone else.
They find you. You go anyway, with a mark against your name.
Your family empties a jar of scrap into the recruiter's hand. He crosses your name out.

events.title: The examination
events.text: The lower-ring examination decides who goes up the mountain and who stays near the gutters.

out.text: You pass. A pale gray uniform. Everyone at home is very proud and very quiet.
You miss by two marks. Nobody says it out loud.
Your friend passes. You don't. They never forget it.

events.title: Lost inside
events.text: On a salvage run you take a wrong turn in a drowned office and your light dies.

out.text: You follow the wall with one hand for an hour that lasts a year. You find the window.
You come out through the roof somehow, half drowned, with a jar of glass you don't remember picking up.
They find you by your humming. You didn't know you were humming.

events.title: Lantern night
events.text: Lantern night. Someone you like is standing alone at the rail.

out.text: You don't say anything. You don't need to.
They move away. Politely.
You write your grandmother's name on the paper. It is a good night anyway.

events.title: Running away
events.text: You could just take a skiff and go.

out.text: You last two weeks on your own. You come back thinner and much harder to impress.
You find a Drifter crew who take you in. You become one of them.
You stay. Something in you keeps the skiff's knots loose, just in case.

events.title: The quiet girl
events.text: A girl on your raft stops talking. Everyone whispers the old word.

out.text: She can't talk but she can write. She writes "it's singing". You keep her company until her family takes her to the Vigil.
You keep away, like everyone. You hear later she's fine. You aren't sure that's true.

events.title: A small run
events.text: A Lowlight runner asks you to carry a sealed bag across two rafts. "Don't open it."

out.text: Easy scrap. You don't open it. You never find out.
A Ward search on the second raft. You drop the bag over the side. Lowlight wants it paid for.
Medicine. Real Highmark medicine, for a raft with sick children. You carry it twice as carefully.

events.title: A light below
events.text: Night swimming. Something glows, far below, between the drowned towers.

out.text: It is a person standing in the water, lit from inside by growth. It doesn't move. You do. Fast.
She listens. "It was someone," she says. "Be kind to it. Be far from it."

events.title: An instrument
events.text: You find a salvage fiddle with two strings.

out.text: By winter you can play three songs. One of them is almost beautiful.
Five scrap. You hear someone else play it on the Exchange for years.

events.title: A boat that doesn't come back
events.text: Your father's fishing boat doesn't come back from the Supply Lanes.

out.text: You search for six days. You find a single oar with his initials.
He comes back on the seventh day, towed by a Ward launch, with a broken leg and a story.
You wait. That is all anyone can do. He is not on the next boat, or the one after.

events.title: A kid follows you
events.text: A small kid starts following you everywhere and copying how you tie knots.

out.text: They become very good. Better than you, one day.
They cry. You feel like the tide.

events.title: The view
events.text: On a clear night you climb the Crow and look at Highmark's lights for an hour.

out.text: You decide, very privately, that one day you will stand on dry ground.
Every light up there is a ration that didn't come here. You decide that, very privately.

events.title: The Keeper's question
events.text: The Keeper asks if you would like to sit the night watch with the novices.

out.text: All night by a candle on the water. Near dawn the water hums and the candle flame bends toward the sound.
"Of course," she says. "The water will ask you again."

events.title: The dead engine
events.text: A trader's engine dies at the dock. Everyone is shouting. You think you can see why.

out.text: Fuel line, cracked. You fix it with tape and nerve. The trader pays you.
You make it worse. Spectacularly worse.

choices.label: Point it out to an adult

out.text: They fix it and take the credit. You learn something about adults.

events.title: Ration day riot
events.text: The ration launch is short by a third. People start shoving.

out.text: You end up throwing a sealed tin at a Warden. Hero to the Stacks, file in the Archives.
You get them out before the Wardens use the batons.
A Ward officer notes your name with approval. Your friends note it too.

events.title: A diver's story
events.text: An old diver tells you about a ring of black stones far down the Sounding, that hums when the Beacon passes.

out.text: You lie awake listening for it. Some nights you think you hear it.
He just nods. "You will," he says.

events.title: Odd jobs
events.text: There is always work for hands on a raft, if not for much.

out.text: Your back aches and your hands harden.
You learn everyone's business. Very useful.
You learn the prices of things that don't have prices.

events.title: Your own bunk
events.text: You could keep your family's bunk, or find your own place.

out.text: A container on the Stacks with a hole in the roof. Yours.
You save scrap and lose a little privacy every year.

events.title: Vance's offer
events.text: Madam Oru Vance's people want a runner. She sees something in you, or says she does.

out.text: You run cargo between rafts. Vance pays fair and remembers everything.
"Pity," she says. "Come back when you're hungrier."

events.title: A yellow permit
events.text: A Highmark provisioner offers you a trader's permit — if you report "irregularities" on your raft.

out.text: Yellow tag on your arm. Cheaper fuel. Fewer people sit with you at dinner.
You file empty reports for two years. Then they notice.
They notice in a month. Permit revoked, name filed.
The provisioner shrugs. "Your loss." It is, a little.

events.title: Cut the cord
events.text: Sal at the night market offers to cut the Deep-Born tally off your sleeve and sell you a drifter's nothing.

out.text: Orange docks. Fewer stares. The dive crews say you're ashamed of them. You are, a bit.
You keep it. It's yours.

events.title: A question
events.text: {partner} asks if you'd marry them on the water.

out.text: A dusk wedding on a borrowed barge. Lanterns. The Keeper ties your wrists with blue thread.
out.best: Marrying {partner} on the water at dusk.

out.text: They say they'll wait. They mean it, mostly.
They take it quietly and leave on the next trader.

events.title: A child
events.text: {partner} says it might be time for a child.

out.text: A child, small and furious and yours.
out.best: The first time you held your child.

out.text: You wait. Some years waiting is a choice and some years it isn't.

events.title: Someone new
events.text: Someone new ties up next to you at the dock and asks for a light.

choices.label: Give them the light and stay

out.text: You talk until the lamps go out.
Pleasant. Nothing more.

choices.label: Give them the light and go

out.text: You wonder about them, later.

events.title: A chance
events.text: Your boss offers you a harder job, more responsibility, more pay.

out.text: You do it well. People start calling you by your title.
You struggle. They give it to someone else.
Safe. Comfortable. A little dull.

events.title: A deep contract
events.text: A man with Highmark shoes and no wristband offers a fortune to dive past the Dark Shelf.

out.text: You go deeper than you have ever been. You come back. The man pays in glass and doesn't blink.
You go deep. You come back without three days of memory and with the tune of the Choir in your chest.
"The Archives," he says, after a long time. You walk away. He makes a note.
He finds someone else. The someone else doesn't come back up.

events.title: Ward 9
events.text: Lowlight wants something from the flooded basement under St. Aldren's quarantine wing.

out.text: You go.

success.text: You come up with a sample of the growth in a jar and something worse: you understand what Ward 9 was for.
success.best: Coming up out of Ward 9 alive.

fail.text: The basement is darker than the job said. You come up empty, coughing, and dream of glowing hands for a year.

out.text: "Fair," says the runner. "Smart." It doesn't sound like a compliment.

events.title: Lantern night
events.text: It's lantern night on Portage. You have a name in your head.

out.text: You go.

success.text: Your lantern goes out with all the others. For one night the Drift is full of names.
success.best: Lantern night, setting a name on the water.

fail.text: You get there late. The lanterns are already far out. You watch them anyway.

out.text: You watch the lights from your bunk window.

events.title: Searchlight
events.text: You're out late with something in your locker you shouldn't have. Engines in the fog.

out.text: You hide.

success.text: The searchlight swings past twice. Then the engine fades. You breathe.

fail.text: They board. They take the locker, a week's scrap and your good mood.

out.text: They search everything. A conscript deckhand pockets your contraband and winks.
They seize the lot and write your name down.

events.title: The midnight storm
events.text: A storm at midnight. Low Row's lines part and a whole raft starts to drift.

out.text: You go.

success.text: You tow them home through the black. Every bunk on Low Row knows your name now.
success.best: Towing Low Row home through the storm.

fail.text: You lose them in the rain. They are found three days later, alive, far out. You couldn't have done more.

out.text: You hold your own lines all night. In the morning a raft is missing.

events.title: A meeting
events.text: A meeting in the Stacks at midnight. People are talking about the rafts refusing the next ration day.

out.text: You speak. People listen. A Ward informer listens too.
You listen. The anger is very old and very reasonable.
A Ward officer thanks you for your service. Three people disappear.

events.title: Ration cut
events.text: Highmark cuts the ration by a quarter. The board on your raft is rewritten in red chalk.

out.text: You feed two families for a month. You are thin. You are not sorry.
You make it through fine. Not everyone does.
Forged seals. They work this time.

events.title: Glow under the raft
events.text: For the first time, there is a faint glow under your own raft at night.

out.text: Growth on the floats, pale and pulsing. It turns toward your breathing.
They scrape it off. It grows back in a week.
You pray to a tide you are less sure of than you were.

events.title: The wedding ring
events.text: A widow on Low Row lost her wedding ring in the drowned church off the north lane.

out.text: You find it on the altar step, under a fall of glass. She cries. You pretend you aren't.
You don't find it. You find a hundred other rings instead and leave them all.

choices.label: Give her one of your own

out.text: It isn't hers. She wears it anyway.

events.title: Medicine
events.text: A child on your raft needs Highmark medicine. Nobody has a permit.

out.text: It works. The child lives. You are in debt to Lowlight for a year.
A physician on the Outer Harbor gives you the medicine and her name, quietly. Kindness in a gray uniform.
Denied. Forms. More forms. The child lives anyway, no thanks to anyone.

choices.label: Steal it from a Ward launch

out.text: You get it. You also get a file.

events.title: A voice in the static
events.text: On a dead frequency you hear a voice reading names. Your name is on the list.

out.text: The voice reads names until dawn. Most of them are drowned. You are not. Yet.
You turn it off. You don't sleep.

events.title: The Keeper
events.text: The Keeper asks you, "What does the water want?"

out.text: She nods slowly. "Then be careful what you say near it."
"Mm," she says. "That is what Highmark says too."
She looks at you for a long time. "Yes," she says. "Some of us."

events.title: Debt
events.text: Vance's collectors come about a loan. You don't remember it being this much.

out.text: You pay. You are poorer and freer.
Vance herself waves them off. "Not this one. Not this year."
They take your engine as collateral.
You disappear into the Hush for a season.

events.title: A Warden
events.text: During a search, a young Warden finds the contraband in your locker. She looks at you, then closes it.

out.text: "I'm from Greentide," she says. "Keep your head down."
She moves on. You never see her again. You think about her often.

events.title: An old face
events.text: {friend} turns up at your dock after years away.

out.text: Like no time passed. Like all of it did.
"Highmark," they say, and show you a blue wristband, and look ashamed of it.

events.title: Your mentor
events.text: {mentor} is dying. They ask for you.

out.text: They give you their dive knife and one piece of advice: "Go quiet."
You don't go. They die without you. You keep their name on a lantern every year.

events.title: A child's bracelet
events.text: Your child is five. It's time for their first bracelet.

out.text: They wear it proudly, then lose it in a week.
Unusual. People talk. Your child grows up unafraid of most things.

events.title: Your child wants to dive
events.text: Your child wants to be a diver.

out.text: You teach them everything you know about being quiet.
They dive anyway, at night, alone. They are fine. You never forgive yourself the fear.

events.title: Captain Marlow
events.text: Captain Sef Marlow of Lowlight sits down next to you without asking. "I hear you're steady."

out.text: Fog, engines off, cargo that doesn't exist.
"I was a captain," he says. "I saw the cargo manifests. Now I'm this." He doesn't elaborate.
The Ward never finds him. Lowlight never forgets you.

events.title: A raft inspection
events.text: As a Warden, you are ordered to seize a raft's medicine for having no permits.

out.text: You seize it. A child on that raft will be sick all winter. The captain commends you.
You "miss" the locker. Your sergeant notices. He also says nothing.
A file opens with your name on it.

events.title: Bram's project
events.text: Bram Hollis wants to build a pump that could lift a whole raft's water. He needs help.

out.text: It takes a year. It works. Rusthold names a bolt after you.
He builds it anyway. It breaks. He builds it again.

events.title: The seed vault
events.text: Someone stole Greentide's seed vault. Elder Koa is calm, which is frightening.

out.text: You find it in a Ward launch's hold, labelled "confiscated". You get it back without a fight, somehow.
You track it to Highmark's Outer Harbor and no further.
Three beans and a potato eye. Koa plants them herself.

events.title: Outer Harbor
events.text: Your permit lets you onto the Outer Harbor of Highmark for one day.

out.text: White terraces, real trees, someone eating an orange. You don't speak for the whole trip back.

choices.label: Try to slip past the gate

out.text: Tide Ward. Detention. A long night in a white room. They let you go with a stamp on your file.
You get two terraces up before anyone looks at your wrist. You touch real soil. Then you leave, fast.

events.title: A Concord dinner
events.text: Somehow you are invited to a Concord dinner as somebody's guest.

out.text: A Seat-holder remembers your name. That is worth more than the meal.
The room goes quiet. Director Voss smiles at you. You are not invited back.

events.title: In the Archives
events.text: Filing old records, you find a folder: PROJECT UNDERTOW — FEEDING SCHEDULE.

out.text: Names. Dates. Raft divers sent down on "survey contracts". A column marked "returned": almost empty.

choices.label: Copy it out for Raft Free Voice

out.text: It goes out on the pirate radio. Highmark calls it a forgery. The rafts know better.
You put it back. You are very careful never to think about it.

events.title: The Choir
events.text: On a night dive, you hear the Choir: a song you feel in your ribs.

out.text: Something huge turns in the dark, far off, and passes. It heard you. It didn't mind.
The song passes over you like weather.

events.title: Something listening
events.text: Your line tender drops a tool on the deck above. Below you, something pale turns toward the sound.

out.text: You hold still until your lungs scream. It passes, close enough to feel the water move.
You hold still. It doesn't pass. Then it does. You come up shaking and never dive with that tender again.
You make it, just. Your tender saw something pale break the surface behind you. She quits the next day.

events.title: Fire on the Stacks
events.text: A fire on the Stacks. Containers burn like stoves.

out.text: Bucket lines in the dark. You save the next three containers.
You save your things. You lose some friends.

events.title: Bad water
events.text: Someone's still was bad. Half the raft is sick.

out.text: A week without sleep. Nobody dies on your shift.
A cracked filter, a dead gull. You fix it. You are a hero for a week.
You can't find it. It passes anyway.

events.title: Rogue wave
events.text: A rogue wave out of a flat sea. Your boat is in its path.

out.text: You climb it bow-first and fall off the back screaming. Alive.
It rolls you. You come up under the hull and find the air pocket by luck.
It catches you anyway. You lose the cargo and keep the boat.

events.title: The Hush
events.text: You wake up with no voice.

out.text: The Keeper sits with you. On the fourth day your voice comes back. It was a cold, nothing more. Probably.
It doesn't come back. You learn to write. You hear the deep singing every night. You are not afraid.
You hide it for a week. It goes. You never tell anyone.

events.title: Halfway
events.text: You are halfway through, if you're lucky.

out.text: You quit, sell your bunk and buy a skiff. Your family thinks you've lost your mind.
You stay. There is a dignity in it, and a weight.

events.title: The vote
events.text: Your raft needs a new steward. People keep looking at you.

out.text: You win by eleven votes.
out.best: Being chosen as steward by your raft.

out.text: You lose by eleven votes. The winner asks you to be her second.
Your candidate wins. You have a friend in power, which is better.

events.title: A reply
events.text: A bottle washes up with your own handwriting in it, and a reply underneath.

out.text: "We are on a raft called Greenshade, far north. We grow apples in a greenhouse. Come and see." No coordinates.
You keep it in your jacket for the rest of your life.

events.title: A raft dog
events.text: A thin raft dog starts sleeping by your door.

out.text: It never leaves your side again. It barks at Wardens. It's right to.
Someone else feeds it. It still sleeps by your door.

events.title: Salt
events.text: Greentide needs salt. Rusthold has too much. You have a boat.

out.text: Buy low, sell high, and the margin is yours.
A storm costs you the cargo halfway.
Koa remembers. Everybody remembers who gave salt.

events.title: A Warden's price
events.text: A Warden says he'll overlook your expired tag for three scrap.

out.text: He pockets it. It happens again next month.
Nothing happens to him. Several things happen to you.
You talk about his mother's raft. He laughs and waves you on.
He doubles it.

events.title: Warm glass
events.text: You find a whole pane of deep-glass in a drowned stairwell. It's warm.

out.text: Vance pays well and asks where. You lie. She knows.
The Keeper holds it to her ear. "It's still singing," she says.
You keep it under your pillow. Your dreams get very loud.

events.title: A memory pool
events.text: In the Cask Street tunnels, a pocket of warm water. Voices in it, like a held breath.

out.text: A child counting stations. A bell. Then everybody says the same word at once, and the word is lost.
You swim on. The voices follow you for a while.

events.title: Rumour of land
events.text: A Drifter swears he's seen a second island, far north, under the aurora.

out.text: You buy him a drink and his chart. The chart is beautiful and probably wrong.
He shrugs. "Someone will find it. Not you."

events.title: Your sibling
events.text: Your sibling is in trouble with Lowlight and needs scrap.

out.text: They cry. They pay you back in a year. Mostly.
They lose their boat. You lose them for a decade.

events.title: Pursuit
events.text: A Ward launch is chasing you through the Wrecklands and your engine is coughing.

out.text: You thread the drowned towers at speed. They don't follow you into Cask Street.
You run aground on a drowned car. They are very polite about arresting you.
You drift in the dark behind a tower. Their searchlight passes over the water twice.

events.title: A brother's recorder
events.text: A salvager sells you a waterlogged recorder. The voice on it says your family name.

out.text: "...if anyone finds this, tell my sister I went down the Sounding on purpose." The rest is static. It might be anyone's brother. It might not.
You keep it in a drawer, unplayed, for years.

events.title: The low tone
events.text: The low tone shakes the water every night now. The Vigil says the Cathedral is waking.

out.text: You go to the Sounding with the Listeners and sit above it all night.
If Highmark is feeding it, starve them both.
You stay home and tie your lines tighter.

events.title: The Sounding
events.text: You know enough now: Undertow, the feeding, the Cathedral. Someone has to decide something.

out.text: You go down with a Rusthold charge and Teo's map. The tone stops. So, in a way, do you.
out.best: Going down to shut the Cathedral down.

out.text: Raft Free Voice reads your files for a week straight. The rafts stop the next ration day. Highmark bends.
out.best: The week the rafts heard the truth.

out.text: You take Voss's offer. A silver wristband. A dry bed. The lie, kept.
You lower every hydrophone on the Drift and play it back its own song. The sea changes overnight.

events.title: At work
events.text: A fat school of mackerel under the drowned flyover.

out.text: You fill the boat twice.
The net snags on a drowned car and tears.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: Blight on the bean vines.

out.text: You catch it early and burn the worst of it.
You lose half the crop.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: The main pump on your raft starts making a new sound.

out.text: You fix it before it fails.
It fails at midnight. You fix it by dawn, barely.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A rumour of a ration cut. Prices are about to move.

out.text: You buy early and sell late.
You buy late and sell early.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A diver is brought up blue and not breathing.

out.text: You bring her back.
You do everything right and she doesn't come back.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: You are asked to play at a funeral at sea.

out.text: Everybody cries in the right places.
A string breaks in the quiet part.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A run through the Hush with no compass.

out.text: You navigate by the sound of the Beacon's foghorn alone.
You come out the wrong side of the fog, right next to a Ward launch.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A night dive in the Drowned Streets.

out.text: You come up with copper, a ring and a full tally mark.
Your light dies at thirty metres.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A sunk ferry in the Wrecklands, full of luggage.

out.text: Nobody has been in for years. You fill the boat.
Someone has. They are still there.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: Night patrol on the south lane.

out.text: Quiet. You share coffee with a raft-born deckhand and talk about home.
You stop a smuggler and find your cousin at the tiller.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: The ration ledgers don't add up.

out.text: You make them add up. You are praised.
You ask why. You are moved to a smaller desk.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A raft child asks why Highmark gets the rain.

out.text: You tell them the truth, gently.
You tell them the official answer. They know.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: You guide a convoy through a fog bank.

out.text: Every boat comes out the other side.
You lose one in the fog. It turns up a day later.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: At work
events.text: A night at the Sounding with the Listeners.

out.text: The tone comes. You understand one word of it.
The tone comes. It understands one word of you.
You do the safe thing. It is fine. Fine is underrated.

events.title: The Tide Ceremony
events.text: At sixty-five, raft-folk are offered the Tide Ceremony: a night on the water, alone, with a lantern.

out.text: All night alone on the water. At dawn you know what you were for.
out.best: The night of your Tide Ceremony.

out.text: You have had enough nights alone on the water, thank you.

events.title: Your gear
events.text: Your dive knife, your charts, your boat. Who gets them?

out.text: They take it all with great seriousness and then use the knife to open tins.
A kid with a blank tally cord. Her face, when you hand her the knife.
You drop it all over the side on a calm morning.

events.title: One last dive
events.text: You want to dive one more time.

out.text: The water holds you like it remembers you.
out.best: Your last dive, at an age when nobody dives.

out.text: Your heart doesn't like it. The water is gentle about it.
You watch the young ones go down and come up laughing.

events.title: Your story
events.text: A Raft Free Voice runner wants your story for the radio.

out.text: They read it out over three nights. People you don't know stop you on the Exchange to say thank you.
It's a good story. It's mostly true.

events.title: A long cough
events.text: A cough that doesn't leave.

out.text: Bitter medicine and rest. It helps.
It settles in like a lodger.

events.title: A grandchild
events.text: Your child brings a baby to show you.

out.text: Small and furious at the cold. Exactly like their parent was.
They are too young to understand. You tell it anyway.

events.title: Old grudges
events.text: You're old enough to be tired of a grudge.

out.text: You share a pipe. Neither of you apologises. Both of you mean it.
It keeps you warm. That's what grudges are for.

events.title: The Beacon
events.text: You count the Beacon's sweeps again, the way you did as a child.

out.text: Fifteen seconds. It never changed. You did.
The water hums. It always did. You just stopped noticing.

events.title: A lantern for you
events.text: On lantern night someone writes your name on a lantern, early, as a joke.

out.text: You laugh until you cough. You write theirs on one too.

choices.label: Set it on the water yourself

out.text: You watch your own name float out to sea. It feels like permission.

events.title: A letter
events.text: A letter from Highmark: an "acknowledgement of historical irregularities in supply". It is not an apology.

out.text: It burns well. Highmark paper always did.

choices.label: Read it on Raft Free Voice

out.text: Your voice cracks on "irregularities". The whole Drift hears it crack.

events.title: A young diver
events.text: A young Deep-Born diver asks you how you got old.

out.text: "Go quiet. Come back." She writes it on her sleeve.
"Luck, and a good tender, and not being stupid twice."

events.title: Storm season
events.text: The worst storm season in years. Rafts break and rejoin like ice.

out.text: Every night for a month. Your hands are rope.
You wait it out. It waits you out right back.

events.title: Something in the water
events.text: Something heavy bumps your boat.

out.text: A sealed toolbox. Somebody's whole life, rusted shut.
A drowned suitcase full of photographs. You keep one.
It sinks. Some things should.

events.title: A gull steals your lunch
events.text: A gull steals your lunch, flies off, and drops a ration seal on your head.

out.text: Best trade you ever made.

events.title: Aurora
events.text: A night so clear the aurora spills down from the north over the whole Drift.

out.text: The whole raft stands on deck in blankets, silent.
You have it to yourself for an hour. It is enough.

events.title: The Long Dark Night
events.text: The Long Dark Night: no moon, no stars, everyone tied up and indoors.

out.text: You stay in, listening to the raft creak. Something walks across the deck above. Nothing is there in the morning.
The glow is everywhere below you, brighter than you've ever seen. You can see the shape of the Cathedral. Nobody believes you.

events.title: A bad winter
events.text: A bad winter. Damp gets into your chest.

out.text: You rest. It passes.
You keep working. It doesn't pass.

events.title: A stranger
events.text: A Drifter with no bracelet and no boat asks you for water.

out.text: They drink, thank you, and are gone. A month later a bag of salt turns up on your bunk.
They go. You think about them in the next drought.

events.title: Night Songs
events.text: Late at night, the Night Songs station plays "Hold the Light for Me".

out.text: You sing it slightly wrong, the way you always have.
Some songs are too much.

events.title: A raid
events.text: The Tide Ward raids your raft looking for a deserter.

out.text: He hides in your bunk under the nets. They don't find him. Lowlight owes you.
They find him in your bunk. They don't find you guilty. Just noted.
They take him away. Nobody on your raft looks at you the same.
They find him anyway. You did nothing, which is something.

events.title: Lanternfish
events.text: A swarm of lanternfish lights up the water under the raft. Then, all at once, they go dark.

out.text: Something passes below. Big. Quiet. Then the light comes back, slowly.
By the time they look, the fish are lit again. You don't say what you felt pass.

events.title: A wedding on the water
events.text: A wedding on Portage. Everyone is invited, which is the rule.

out.text: You dance until the barge leans.
You make stew for two hundred. It is mostly stew.

events.title: A funeral at sea
events.text: A funeral at sea for an old fisher. A lantern, a song, a long silence.

out.text: Your voice carries further over the water than you meant it to.
You stand at the back and hold the rail.

events.title: Market day
events.text: Market day on the Exchange: noise, smoke, lies about prices.

out.text: You get the best price on the raft and the worst reputation.
Odile sees you coming from a mile off.
You buy nothing and eat a hot fish bun. Perfect day.

events.title: The dock
events.text: A dockmaster won't let you tie up because of the colour of your wrist.

out.text: You argue. You lose. You tie up at the red lamp, round the back, like always.
You tie up at the red lamp. Someone has left a lantern lit there for you anyway.

events.title: Madam Vance
events.text: Madam Oru Vance pours you tea on the Exchange, in front of everyone, wristband and all.

out.text: It's terrible tea. Everybody sees. That was the point.
"Because your money's the same colour as everyone else's," she says. "And because I knew your brother."

events.title: Borrowed colours
events.text: A raft-born friend offers to swap bracelets with you for a day so you can see the Exchange from the green dock.

out.text: For one day nobody steps back from you. It is the strangest day of your life.
A dockmaster checks. Both of you are in trouble.
"It's mine," you say. Your friend respects that more than they expected to.

events.title: The raft that wants to leave
events.text: Some families on your raft want to cut loose and drift north, away from Highmark's lanes.

out.text: The vote fails by four. The idea doesn't.
You stay where the rations come. It is the sensible choice. You hate it a little.

events.title: The lighthouse keeper
events.text: The keeper of the old harbour light off the Wrecklands hasn't lit it for a week.

out.text: He's fine. He ran out of oil and was too proud to ask. You bring him oil. He gives you a chart.
The Ward doesn't go. The light stays dark. A trader runs aground in the spring.

events.title: Your boat is gone
events.text: Your boat isn't where you tied it.

out.text: You find it at the night market, half repainted. Sal gives it back with an apology and a bottle.
Gone. You borrow a skiff and start again.
You let it go. Somebody needed it more, you tell yourself.

events.title: A crew of your own
events.text: You have enough scrap to hire a hand for your boat.

out.text: She says nothing for a year and saves your life twice.
He never stops talking. Wardens love him. Your inspections get much shorter.

events.title: A photograph
events.text: A trader is selling old photographs by the handful. Strangers on dry streets.

out.text: A woman laughing on a dry beach. You keep it on your wall. People ask if she's family. You say yes.
"Library at the bottom of Orrin Bay," he says. "Pages float. Photographs float."

events.title: A cut wristband
events.text: A boy on the Exchange has cut off his bracelet and is shouting that colours are a Highmark trick.

out.text: Some people cheer. A Ward informer writes down your face.
You walk past. You think about it for a long time.

events.title: A quiet morning
events.text: Sunrise on flat water. Nothing is happening. Everyone you love is asleep.

out.text: The sun comes up out of the sea, as it has every day of your life. You are glad you saw this one.
out.best: A quiet sunrise on flat water, late in life.

events.title: A child who hums
events.text: A child on your raft hums a tune nobody taught her, and the growth under the floats pulses in time.

out.text: The growth pulses brighter. The child laughs. You stop, carefully.
The Keeper listens and goes very still. "Keep her near the Vigil," she says.
